				var:zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_owner_2 = $TICKET_OWNER$
				var:zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_cycle_2 >= 1
				var:zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_case_2 > 0
				var:zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_m357_receipt_id_2 > 0
				var:zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_m357_receipt_hash_2 > 0
				var:zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_m358_receipt_id_2 > 0
				var:zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_m358_receipt_hash_2 > 0
				var:zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_m359_receipt_id_2 > 0
				var:zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_m359_receipt_hash_2 > 0
				var:zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_owner_3 = $TICKET_OWNER$
				var:zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_cycle_3 >= 1
				var:zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_case_3 > 0
				var:zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_m357_receipt_id_3 > 0
				var:zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_m357_receipt_hash_3 > 0
				var:zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_m358_receipt_id_3 > 0
				var:zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_m358_receipt_hash_3 > 0
				var:zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_m359_receipt_id_3 > 0
				var:zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_m359_receipt_hash_3 > 0
			}
		}
		$TICKET_OWNER$ = {
			change_variable = { name = zg361_we_realm_charter_report_serial add = 1 }
			change_variable = { name = zg361_we_realm_charter_id_serial add = 1 }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m361_evidence_count value = 3 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m361_evidence_ready value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m361_evidence_consumed value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m361_evidence_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m361_evidence_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m361_evidence_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m361_evidence_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m361_evidence_state value = 5 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m361_prepared_report_id value = var:zg361_case_al_owner.var:zg361_we_realm_charter_report_serial }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m361_prepared_charter_id value = var:zg361_case_al_owner.var:zg361_we_realm_charter_id_serial }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m361_prepared_previous_charter_id value = var:zg361_case_al_owner.var:zg361_we_realm_charter_current_id }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m361_prepared_previous_version value = var:zg361_case_al_owner.var:zg361_we_realm_charter_current_version }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m361_prepared_adopted_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m361_prepared_effective_cycle value = { value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ add = 1 } }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m361_evidence_owner_1 value = var:zg361_case_al_owner.var:zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_owner_1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m361_evidence_subject_1 value = var:zg361_case_al_owner.var:zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_subject_1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m361_evidence_cycle_1 value = var:zg361_case_al_owner.var:zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_cycle_1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m361_evidence_case_1 value = var:zg361_case_al_owner.var:zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_case_1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m361_evidence_m357_receipt_id_1 value = var:zg361_case_al_owner.var:zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_m357_receipt_id_1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m361_evidence_m357_receipt_hash_1 value = var:zg361_case_al_owner.var:zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_m357_receipt_hash_1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m361_evidence_m358_receipt_id_1 value = var:zg361_case_al_owner.var:zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_m358_receipt_id_1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m361_evidence_m358_receipt_hash_1 value = var:zg361_case_al_owner.var:zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_m358_receipt_hash_1 }

		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m361_evidence_m359_receipt_hash_1 value = var:zg361_case_al_owner.var:zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_m359_receipt_hash_1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m361_evidence_owner_2 value = var:zg361_case_al_owner.var:zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_owner_2 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m361_evidence_subject_2 value = var:zg361_case_al_owner.var:zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_subject_2 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m361_evidence_cycle_2 value = var:zg361_case_al_owner.var:zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_cycle_2 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m361_evidence_case_2 value = var:zg361_case_al_owner.var:zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_case_2 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m361_evidence_m357_receipt_id_2 value = var:zg361_case_al_owner.var:zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_m357_receipt_id_2 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m361_evidence_m357_receipt_hash_2 value = var:zg361_case_al_owner.var:zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_m357_receipt_hash_2 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m361_evidence_m358_receipt_id_2 value = var:zg361_case_al_owner.var:zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_m358_receipt_id_2 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m361_evidence_m358_receipt_hash_2 value = var:zg361_case_al_owner.var:zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_m358_receipt_hash_2 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m361_evidence_m359_receipt_id_2 value = var:zg361_case_al_owner.var:zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_m359_receipt_id_2 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m361_evidence_m359_receipt_hash_2 value = var:zg361_case_al_owner.var:zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_m359_receipt_hash_2 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m361_evidence_owner_3 value = var:zg361_case_al_owner.var:zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_owner_3 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m361_evidence_subject_3 value = var:zg361_case_al_owner.var:zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_subject_3 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m361_evidence_cycle_3 value = var:zg361_case_al_owner.var:zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_cycle_3 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m361_evidence_case_3 value = var:zg361_case_al_owner.var:zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_case_3 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m361_evidence_m357_receipt_id_3 value = var:zg361_case_al_owner.var:zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_m357_receipt_id_3 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m361_evidence_m357_receipt_hash_3 value = var:zg361_case_al_owner.var:zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_m357_receipt_hash_3 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m361_evidence_m358_receipt_id_3 value = var:zg361_case_al_owner.var:zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_m358_receipt_id_3 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m361_evidence_m358_receipt_hash_3 value = var:zg361_case_al_owner.var:zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_m358_receipt_hash_3 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m361_evidence_m359_receipt_id_3 value = var:zg361_case_al_owner.var:zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_m359_receipt_id_3 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m361_evidence_m359_receipt_hash_3 value = var:zg361_case_al_owner.var:zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_m359_receipt_hash_3 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_adapter_status value = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = zg361_we_m361_evidence_ready
			var:zg361_we_m361_evidence_ready = 1
			var:zg361_we_m361_evidence_owner = $TICKET_OWNER$

			var:zg361_we_m361_evidence_cycle = $TICKET_CYCLE$
			var:zg361_we_m361_evidence_case = $TICKET_CASE$
			var:zg361_we_m361_evidence_state = 5
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_adapter_status value = 2 }
	}
	else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_we_adapter_status value = 4 } set_variable = { name = zg361_we_adapter_blocked_reason value = 3612 } }
}

# The first two distinct cycles have no three-cycle
# report yet.  After #360 they close as an honest history-accruing terminal;
# no #361 receipt, business object, charter or success is fabricated.
zg361_we_finalize_history_accruing_effect = {
	remove_variable = zg361_we_runtime_applied
	save_scope_as = zg361_we_history_finalize_subject
	if = {
		limit = {
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_al_owner SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_al_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_al_cycle_serial CASE_VAR = zg361_case_al_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_al_state ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_al_active
				EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_al_owner EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_al_cycle_serial EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_al_case_serial
				EXPECTED_STATE = 5
			}
			var:zg361_case_al_owner = {
				has_variable = zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_count
				var:zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_count >= 1
				var:zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_count <= 3
				var:zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_last_owner = this
				var:zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_last_subject = scope:zg361_we_history_finalize_subject
				var:zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_last_cycle = scope:zg361_we_history_finalize_subject.var:zg361_case_al_cycle_serial
				var:zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_last_case = scope:zg361_we_history_finalize_subject.var:zg361_case_al_case_serial
				OR = {
					var:zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_count < 3
					AND = { exists = liege liege = { zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes } }
				}
			}
			has_variable = zg361_we_operation_total
			has_variable = zg361_we_operation_used
			has_variable = zg361_we_gold_total
			has_variable = zg361_we_gold_available
			has_variable = zg361_we_gold_reserved
			has_variable = zg361_we_gold_paid
			has_variable = zg361_we_hours_total
			has_variable = zg361_we_hours_available
			has_variable = zg361_we_hours_output
			has_variable = zg361_we_hours_on_call
			has_variable = zg361_we_hours_meeting
			has_variable = zg361_we_hours_leave
			has_variable = zg361_we_hours_governance
			has_variable = zg361_we_shadow_hc_total
			has_variable = zg361_we_shadow_hc_available
			has_variable = zg361_we_shadow_hc_active
			has_variable = zg361_ch_hc_authorized
			has_variable = zg361_ch_hc_available
			has_variable = zg361_ch_hc_reserved
			has_variable = zg361_ch_hc_occupied
			has_variable = zg361_ch_hc_frozen
			has_variable = zg361_ch_hc_reclaimed
			var:zg361_we_operation_total = 40
			var:zg361_we_operation_used = 39
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_portfolio_closed value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_portfolio_status value = 4 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_final_operation_check value = var:zg361_we_operation_used }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_final_gold_check value = var:zg361_we_gold_available }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_we_final_gold_check add = var:zg361_we_gold_reserved }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_we_final_gold_check add = var:zg361_we_gold_paid }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_final_hours_check value = var:zg361_we_hours_available }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_we_final_hours_check add = var:zg361_we_hours_output }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_we_final_hours_check add = var:zg361_we_hours_on_call }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_we_final_hours_check add = var:zg361_we_hours_meeting }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_we_final_hours_check add = var:zg361_we_hours_leave }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_we_final_hours_check add = var:zg361_we_hours_governance }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_final_shadow_hc_check value = var:zg361_we_shadow_hc_available }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_we_final_shadow_hc_check add = var:zg361_we_shadow_hc_active }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_final_formal_hc_check value = var:zg361_ch_hc_available }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_we_final_formal_hc_check add = var:zg361_ch_hc_reserved }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_we_final_formal_hc_check add = var:zg361_ch_hc_occupied }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_we_final_formal_hc_check add = var:zg361_ch_hc_frozen }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_we_final_formal_hc_check add = var:zg361_ch_hc_reclaimed }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_final_conservation_ok value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:zg361_we_final_operation_check = 39
				var:zg361_we_gold_available >= 0
				var:zg361_we_gold_reserved >= 0
				var:zg361_we_gold_paid >= 0
				var:zg361_we_final_gold_check = var:zg361_we_gold_total
				var:zg361_we_hours_available >= 0
				var:zg361_we_hours_output >= 0
				var:zg361_we_hours_on_call >= 0
				var:zg361_we_hours_meeting >= 0
				var:zg361_we_hours_leave >= 0
				var:zg361_we_hours_governance >= 0
				var:zg361_we_final_hours_check = var:zg361_we_hours_total
				var:zg361_we_shadow_hc_available >= 0
				var:zg361_we_shadow_hc_active >= 0
				var:zg361_we_final_shadow_hc_check = var:zg361_we_shadow_hc_total
				var:zg361_ch_hc_available >= 0
				var:zg361_ch_hc_reserved >= 0
				var:zg361_ch_hc_occupied >= 0
				var:zg361_ch_hc_frozen >= 0
				var:zg361_ch_hc_reclaimed >= 0
				var:zg361_we_final_formal_hc_check = var:zg361_ch_hc_authorized
			}
			zg361_case_kernel_transition_effect = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_al_owner SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_al_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_al_cycle_serial CASE_VAR = zg361_case_al_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_al_state REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_al_revision
				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_al_active TIMELINE_VAR = zg361_case_al_timeline_serial
				FEEDBACK_VAR = zg361_case_al_feedback_revision LAST_HOOK_VAR = zg361_case_al_last_hook
				TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_case_al_owner TICKET_SUBJECT = this
				TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_al_cycle_serial TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_al_case_serial
				TICKET_STATE = 5 NEXT_STATE = 8 HOOK_ID = 9362 CLOSE_CASE = yes
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = zg361_case_kernel_applied var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 var:zg361_case_al_active = 0 var:zg361_case_al_state = 8 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_we_final_conservation_ok value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_we_portfolio_terminal_history_accruing value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_we_portfolio_history_cycle_count value = var:zg361_case_al_owner.var:zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_count }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_we_portfolio_terminal_owned_operations value = 39 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_we_portfolio_terminal_skipped_charter value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_we_portfolio_terminal_success value = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_we_portfolio_closed value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_we_portfolio_status value = 8 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_we_runtime_applied value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_we_runtime_status value = 1 }
				debug_log = "ZG361WE: portfolio closed after #360 while official history accrues"
			}
			else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_we_last_red_code value = 9097 } set_variable = { name = zg361_we_runtime_status value = 4 } }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = zg361_we_last_red_code value = 9097 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_we_runtime_status value = 4 }
			debug_log = "ZG361WE RED: history-accruing conservation failed; AL remains active"
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = zg361_we_portfolio_terminal_history_accruing var:zg361_we_portfolio_terminal_history_accruing = 1 var:zg361_we_portfolio_closed = 1 var:zg361_we_portfolio_status = 8 var:zg361_case_al_active = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_runtime_status value = 2 }
	}
	else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_we_last_red_code value = 9097 } set_variable = { name = zg361_we_runtime_status value = 4 } }
}

# #360 is the history gate: cycles one and two close honestly;
# cycle three (and later rolling windows) alone prepares and exposes #361.
zg361_we_after_m360_history_gate_effect = {
	remove_variable = zg361_we_adapter_status
	remove_variable = zg361_we_adapter_blocked_reason
	save_scope_as = zg361_we_history_gate_subject
	if = {
		limit = {
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_al_owner SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_al_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_al_cycle_serial CASE_VAR = zg361_case_al_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_al_state ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_al_active
				EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_al_owner EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_al_cycle_serial EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_al_case_serial
				EXPECTED_STATE = 5
			}
			var:zg361_case_al_owner = {
				has_variable = zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_count
				var:zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_count >= 1
				var:zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_count <= 3
				var:zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_last_owner = this
				var:zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_last_subject = scope:zg361_we_history_gate_subject
				var:zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_last_cycle = scope:zg361_we_history_gate_subject.var:zg361_case_al_cycle_serial
				var:zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_last_case = scope:zg361_we_history_gate_subject.var:zg361_case_al_case_serial
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:zg361_case_al_owner = {
					var:zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_count = 3
					trigger_if = { limit = { exists = liege } NOT = { liege = { zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes } } }
					trigger_else = { always = yes }
				}
			}
			zg361_we_prepare_m361_charter_evidence_effect = {
				TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_case_al_owner TICKET_SUBJECT = this
				TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_al_cycle_serial TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_al_case_serial
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = { var:zg361_we_adapter_status = 1 var:zg361_we_adapter_status = 2 }
					has_variable = zg361_we_m361_evidence_ready
					var:zg361_we_m361_evidence_ready = 1
					var:zg361_we_m361_evidence_owner = var:zg361_case_al_owner
					var:zg361_we_m361_evidence_subject = this
					var:zg361_we_m361_evidence_cycle = var:zg361_case_al_cycle_serial
					var:zg361_we_m361_evidence_case = var:zg361_case_al_case_serial
				}
				zg361_we_al_schedule_stage_05_deadline_effect = yes
				if = {
					limit = { var:zg361_case_al_owner = { is_ai = yes zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes } }
					zg361_we_m361_route_a_effect = {
						TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_case_al_owner TICKET_SUBJECT = this
						TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_al_cycle_serial TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_al_case_serial
					}
				}
			}
			else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_we_last_red_code value = 3613 } set_variable = { name = zg361_we_runtime_status value = 4 } }
		}
		else = { zg361_we_finalize_history_accruing_effect = yes }
	}
	else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_we_last_red_code value = 3614 } set_variable = { name = zg361_we_runtime_status value = 4 } }
}

# #262 freezes one real host manager.  Prefer the owner's own
# eligible celestial liege, then the strongest other eligible manager-vassal.
# No candidate means typed blocked; this effect never invents a character.
zg361_we_ac_freeze_m262_host_manager_effect = {
	remove_variable = zg361_we_m262_host_selection_status
	remove_variable = zg361_we_m262_host_selection_blocked_reason
	if = {
		limit = {
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ac_owner SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ac_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ac_cycle_serial CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ac_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ac_state ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ac_active
				EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$ EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$ EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$ EXPECTED_STATE = 4
			}
			$TICKET_SUBJECT$ = this
			has_variable = zg361_we_m262_host_owner
			has_variable = zg361_we_m262_host_subject
			has_variable = zg361_we_m262_host_cycle
			has_variable = zg361_we_m262_host_case
			has_variable = zg361_we_ac_external_secondment_host_manager
			var:zg361_we_m262_host_owner = $TICKET_OWNER$
			var:zg361_we_m262_host_subject = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
			var:zg361_we_m262_host_cycle = $TICKET_CYCLE$
			var:zg361_we_m262_host_case = $TICKET_CASE$
			var:zg361_we_ac_external_secondment_host_manager = { zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes }
			NOT = { var:zg361_we_ac_external_secondment_host_manager = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
			NOT = { var:zg361_we_ac_external_secondment_host_manager = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m262_host_selection_status value = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ac_owner SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ac_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ac_cycle_serial CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ac_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ac_state ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ac_active
				EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$ EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$ EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$ EXPECTED_STATE = 4
			}
			$TICKET_OWNER$ = { zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes }
			$TICKET_SUBJECT$ = this
		}
		remove_variable = zg361_we_ac_external_secondment_host_manager
		remove_variable = zg361_we_m262_host_owner
		remove_variable = zg361_we_m262_host_subject
		remove_variable = zg361_we_m262_host_cycle
		remove_variable = zg361_we_m262_host_case
		save_temporary_scope_as = zg361_we_m262_host_subject_scope
		$TICKET_OWNER$ = {
			save_temporary_scope_as = zg361_we_m262_host_owner_scope
			if = {
				limit = { exists = liege liege = { zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes NOT = { this = scope:zg361_we_m262_host_subject_scope } } }
				liege = { save_temporary_scope_as = zg361_we_m262_host_candidate_scope }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { exists = scope:zg361_we_m262_host_candidate_scope } }
				ordered_vassal = {
					limit = { zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes NOT = { this = scope:zg361_we_m262_host_subject_scope } }
					order_by = stewardship
					position = 0
					save_temporary_scope_as = zg361_we_m262_host_candidate_scope
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:zg361_we_m262_host_candidate_scope }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_we_ac_external_secondment_host_manager value = scope:zg361_we_m262_host_candidate_scope }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m262_host_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m262_host_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m262_host_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m262_host_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m262_host_selection_status value = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m262_host_selection_status value = 4 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m262_host_selection_blocked_reason value = 2621 }
		}
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m262_host_selection_status value = 4 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m262_host_selection_blocked_reason value = 2622 }
	}
}

# human, each milestone receipt is generated only by that player's explicit
# response option.  The authorized AI exception executes the same guarded
# milestones in the background and never receives a visible player event.

		limit = { var:zg361_we_m264_handoff_flow_active = 1 var:zg361_we_m264_handoff_flow_consumed = 0 var:zg361_we_m264_handoff_subject = this var:zg361_we_m264_handoff_step = 1 }
		save_scope_as = zg361_we_m264_handoff_subject_scope
		var:zg361_we_m264_handoff_owner = { save_scope_as = zg361_we_m264_handoff_owner_scope }
		if = { limit = { is_ai = no } trigger_event = { id = zg361we.5264 } }
		else_if = { limit = { var:zg361_we_m264_handoff_owner = { is_ai = no } } var:zg361_we_m264_handoff_owner = { trigger_event = { id = zg361we.5264 } } }
		else = { zg361_we_m264_complete_documentation_effect = yes }
	}
}

zg361_we_m264_queue_owner_review_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = zg361_we_m264_handoff_flow_active
			has_variable = zg361_we_m264_handoff_flow_consumed
			has_variable = zg361_we_m264_handoff_owner
			has_variable = zg361_we_m264_handoff_subject
			has_variable = zg361_we_m264_handoff_cycle
			has_variable = zg361_we_m264_handoff_case
			has_variable = zg361_we_m264_handoff_response
			var:zg361_we_m264_handoff_flow_active = 1
			var:zg361_we_m264_handoff_flow_consumed = 0
			var:zg361_we_m264_handoff_subject = this
			OR = { var:zg361_we_m264_handoff_response = 1 var:zg361_we_m264_handoff_response = 2 }
			var:zg361_case_ac_active = 1
			var:zg361_case_ac_state = 6
			var:zg361_case_ac_owner = var:zg361_we_m264_handoff_owner
			var:zg361_case_ac_subject = this
			var:zg361_case_ac_cycle_serial = var:zg361_we_m264_handoff_cycle
			var:zg361_case_ac_case_serial = var:zg361_we_m264_handoff_case
		}
		var:zg361_we_m264_handoff_owner = { save_scope_as = zg361_we_ac_owner }
		save_scope_as = zg361_we_ac_subject
		save_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_we_ac_cycle value = var:zg361_we_m264_handoff_cycle }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_we_ac_case value = var:zg361_we_m264_handoff_case }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m264_handoff_owner_queued value = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { var:zg361_we_m264_handoff_owner = { is_ai = yes } }
			if = {
				limit = { var:zg361_we_m264_handoff_response = 1 }
				zg361_we_m264_route_a_effect = { TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_we_m264_handoff_owner TICKET_SUBJECT = this TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_we_m264_handoff_cycle TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_we_m264_handoff_case }
			}
			else = { zg361_we_m264_route_b_effect = { TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_we_m264_handoff_owner TICKET_SUBJECT = this TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_we_m264_handoff_cycle TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_we_m264_handoff_case } }
			if = { limit = { has_variable = zg361_we_runtime_applied var:zg361_we_runtime_applied = 1 } zg361_we_m265_route_a_effect = { TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_case_ac_owner TICKET_SUBJECT = this TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_ac_cycle_serial TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_ac_case_serial } }
		}
		else = { var:zg361_we_m264_handoff_owner = { trigger_event = { id = zg361we.264 } } }
	}
}

# Native court-position assignment remains external.  This adapter accepts only
# an already-confirmed appointment receipt bound to the live offer tuple.
zg361_we_submit_ad_appointment_receipt_effect = {
	remove_variable = zg361_we_adapter_status
	remove_variable = zg361_we_adapter_blocked_reason
	if = {
		limit = {
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ad_owner SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ad_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ad_cycle_serial CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ad_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ad_state ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ad_active
				EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$ EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$ EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$ EXPECTED_STATE = 4
			}
			$TICKET_OWNER$ = { zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes }
			$TICKET_SUBJECT$ = this
			trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable = zg361_we_ad_external_appointment_ready } var:zg361_we_ad_external_appointment_ready = 0 } trigger_else = { always = yes }
			has_variable = zg361_we_m272_offer_candidate
			has_variable = zg361_we_m273_candidate_fingerprint
			var:zg361_we_m272_offer_candidate = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
			var:zg361_we_m273_candidate_fingerprint = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
			$APPOINTING_OWNER$ = $TICKET_OWNER$
			$APPOINTMENT_CONFIRMED$ = 1
			$POSITION_TYPE_ID$ > 0
			$POSITION_RECEIPT_ID$ > 0
			$POSITION_RECEIPT_HASH$ > 0
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_ad_external_appointment_ready value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_ad_external_appointment_consumed value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_ad_external_appointing_owner value = $APPOINTING_OWNER$ }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_ad_external_position_type_id value = $POSITION_TYPE_ID$ }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_ad_external_position_receipt_id value = $POSITION_RECEIPT_ID$ }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_ad_external_position_receipt_hash value = $POSITION_RECEIPT_HASH$ }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_ad_appointment_receipt_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_ad_appointment_receipt_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_ad_appointment_receipt_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_ad_appointment_receipt_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_ad_appointment_receipt_state value = 4 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_adapter_status value = 1 }
	}
	else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_we_adapter_status value = 4 } set_variable = { name = zg361_we_adapter_blocked_reason value = 2741 } }
}

# Consume the canonical Central recruitment source for #275.  The caller may
# provide only the original five-tuple; runner identity, evidence, new case and
# receipt/hash are joined from Central's committed subject-local source.
# The #266 reservation/receipt and formal HC count remain untouched.  A
# successful consume transfers the existing owner flight from the refused case
# to Central's distinct new case; it never reserves or releases another slot.
zg361_we_consume_m275_runner_reopen_effect = {
	remove_variable = zg361_we_adapter_status
	remove_variable = zg361_we_adapter_blocked_reason
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = zg361_we_m275_runner_reopen_pending
			var:zg361_we_m275_runner_reopen_pending = 1
			has_variable = zg361_we_m275_business_object_created
			has_variable = zg361_we_m275_object_owner
			has_variable = zg361_we_m275_object_subject
			has_variable = zg361_we_m275_object_cycle
			has_variable = zg361_we_m275_object_case
			has_variable = zg361_we_m275_object_state
			has_variable = zg361_we_m275_object_consumed
			has_variable = zg361_we_m275_consumer_resolve_offer_refusal_hc_hold_275
			var:zg361_we_m275_business_object_created = 1
			var:zg361_we_m275_object_owner = $TICKET_OWNER$
			var:zg361_we_m275_object_subject = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
			var:zg361_we_m275_object_cycle = $TICKET_CYCLE$
			var:zg361_we_m275_object_case = $TICKET_CASE$
			var:zg361_we_m275_object_state = 4
			var:zg361_we_m275_object_consumed = 1
			var:zg361_we_m275_consumer_resolve_offer_refusal_hc_hold_275 = 1
			has_variable = zg361_we_m275_receipt_choice
			has_variable = zg361_we_m275_refusal
			has_variable = zg361_we_m275_not_applicable_hired
			has_variable = zg361_we_m275_hold_pending
			has_variable = zg361_we_m275_runner_up
			has_variable = zg361_we_m275_runner_up_evidence
			has_variable = zg361_we_m275_hc_lineage_receipt
			has_variable = zg361_we_candidate_active
			has_variable = zg361_we_m266_hc_reservation_active
			has_variable = zg361_we_m266_hc_receipt
			var:zg361_we_m275_receipt_choice = 1
			var:zg361_we_m275_refusal = 1
			var:zg361_we_m275_not_applicable_hired = 0
			var:zg361_we_m275_hold_pending = 1
			var:zg361_we_candidate_active = 0
			var:zg361_we_m266_hc_reservation_active = 1
			var:zg361_we_m266_hc_receipt = var:zg361_we_m275_hc_lineage_receipt
			var:zg361_we_m275_write_owner = $TICKET_OWNER$
			var:zg361_we_m275_write_subject = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
			var:zg361_we_m275_write_cycle = $TICKET_CYCLE$
			var:zg361_we_m275_write_case = $TICKET_CASE$
			NOT = { var:zg361_we_m275_runner_up = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
			var:zg361_we_m275_runner_up_evidence > 0
			$TICKET_OWNER$ = {
				has_variable = zg361_we_ad_hc_flight_pending
				var:zg361_we_ad_hc_flight_pending = 1
				var:zg361_we_ad_hc_flight_subject = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
				var:zg361_we_ad_hc_flight_cycle = $TICKET_CYCLE$
				var:zg361_we_ad_hc_flight_case = $TICKET_CASE$
			}
			has_variable = zg361_p2c_m275_requisition_committed
			has_variable = zg361_p2c_m275_requisition_pending
			has_variable = zg361_p2c_m275_requisition_consumed
			has_variable = zg361_p2c_m275_requisition_owner
			has_variable = zg361_p2c_m275_requisition_original_subject
			has_variable = zg361_p2c_m275_requisition_source_cycle
			has_variable = zg361_p2c_m275_requisition_source_case
			has_variable = zg361_p2c_m275_requisition_source_state
			has_variable = zg361_p2c_m275_requisition_runner_up
			has_variable = zg361_p2c_m275_requisition_runner_evidence
			has_variable = zg361_p2c_m275_requisition_hc_lineage_receipt
			has_variable = zg361_p2c_m275_requisition_hc_flight_case
			has_variable = zg361_p2c_m275_requisition_new_case
			has_variable = zg361_p2c_m275_requisition_new_state
			has_variable = zg361_p2c_m275_requisition_receipt_id
			has_variable = zg361_p2c_m275_requisition_receipt_hash
			has_variable = zg361_p2c_m275_requisition_opened
			var:zg361_p2c_m275_requisition_committed = 1
			var:zg361_p2c_m275_requisition_pending = 1
			var:zg361_p2c_m275_requisition_consumed = 0
			var:zg361_p2c_m275_requisition_owner = $TICKET_OWNER$
			var:zg361_p2c_m275_requisition_original_subject = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
			var:zg361_p2c_m275_requisition_source_cycle = $TICKET_CYCLE$
			var:zg361_p2c_m275_requisition_source_case = $TICKET_CASE$
			var:zg361_p2c_m275_requisition_source_state = 4
			var:zg361_p2c_m275_requisition_runner_up = var:zg361_we_m275_runner_up
			var:zg361_p2c_m275_requisition_runner_evidence = var:zg361_we_m275_runner_up_evidence
			var:zg361_p2c_m275_requisition_hc_lineage_receipt = var:zg361_we_m275_hc_lineage_receipt
			var:zg361_p2c_m275_requisition_hc_flight_case = $TICKET_CASE$
			var:zg361_p2c_m275_requisition_new_case > 0
			NOT = { var:zg361_p2c_m275_requisition_new_case = $TICKET_CASE$ }
			var:zg361_p2c_m275_requisition_new_state = 1
			var:zg361_p2c_m275_requisition_receipt_id > 0
			var:zg361_p2c_m275_requisition_receipt_hash > 0
			var:zg361_p2c_m275_requisition_opened = 1
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m275_runner_new_case value = var:zg361_p2c_m275_requisition_new_case }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m275_runner_requisition_receipt_id value = var:zg361_p2c_m275_requisition_receipt_id }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m275_runner_requisition_receipt_hash value = var:zg361_p2c_m275_requisition_receipt_hash }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m275_runner_requisition_candidate value = var:zg361_p2c_m275_requisition_runner_up }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m275_runner_requisition_evidence value = var:zg361_p2c_m275_requisition_runner_evidence }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_candidate_active value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_candidate_active_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_candidate_active_case value = var:zg361_p2c_m275_requisition_new_case }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_candidate_active_character value = var:zg361_p2c_m275_requisition_runner_up }
		$TICKET_OWNER$ = { set_variable = { name = zg361_we_ad_hc_flight_case value = root.var:zg361_p2c_m275_requisition_new_case } }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m275_runner_attempt_opened value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m275_old_attempt_reopened value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m275_hold_released value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m275_hold_pending value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m275_runner_reopen_pending value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m275_runner_reopen_consumed value = 1 } # consumer commit last
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_adapter_status value = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = zg361_we_m275_runner_reopen_consumed
			var:zg361_we_m275_runner_reopen_consumed = 1
			var:zg361_we_m275_object_owner = $TICKET_OWNER$
			var:zg361_we_m275_object_subject = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
			var:zg361_we_m275_object_cycle = $TICKET_CYCLE$
			var:zg361_we_m275_object_case = $TICKET_CASE$
			var:zg361_we_m275_object_state = 4
			has_variable = zg361_p2c_m275_requisition_committed
			var:zg361_p2c_m275_requisition_committed = 1
			var:zg361_p2c_m275_requisition_owner = $TICKET_OWNER$
			var:zg361_p2c_m275_requisition_original_subject = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
			var:zg361_p2c_m275_requisition_source_cycle = $TICKET_CYCLE$
			var:zg361_p2c_m275_requisition_source_case = $TICKET_CASE$
			OR = {
				AND = { var:zg361_p2c_m275_requisition_pending = 1 var:zg361_p2c_m275_requisition_consumed = 0 }
				AND = { var:zg361_p2c_m275_requisition_pending = 0 var:zg361_p2c_m275_requisition_consumed = 1 }
			}
			var:zg361_we_m275_runner_new_case = var:zg361_p2c_m275_requisition_new_case
			var:zg361_we_m275_runner_requisition_receipt_id = var:zg361_p2c_m275_requisition_receipt_id
			var:zg361_we_m275_runner_requisition_receipt_hash = var:zg361_p2c_m275_requisition_receipt_hash
			var:zg361_we_m275_runner_requisition_candidate = var:zg361_p2c_m275_requisition_runner_up
			var:zg361_we_m275_runner_requisition_evidence = var:zg361_p2c_m275_requisition_runner_evidence
			var:zg361_we_candidate_active = 1
			var:zg361_we_candidate_active_owner = $TICKET_OWNER$
			var:zg361_we_candidate_active_case = var:zg361_p2c_m275_requisition_new_case
			var:zg361_we_candidate_active_character = var:zg361_p2c_m275_requisition_runner_up
			var:zg361_we_m275_hold_pending = 0
			var:zg361_we_m275_runner_reopen_pending = 0
			var:zg361_we_m266_hc_reservation_active = 1
			var:zg361_we_m266_hc_receipt = var:zg361_p2c_m275_requisition_hc_lineage_receipt
			$TICKET_OWNER$ = {
				has_variable = zg361_we_ad_hc_flight_pending
				var:zg361_we_ad_hc_flight_pending = 1
				var:zg361_we_ad_hc_flight_subject = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
				var:zg361_we_ad_hc_flight_cycle = $TICKET_CYCLE$
				var:zg361_we_ad_hc_flight_case = root.var:zg361_p2c_m275_requisition_new_case
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_adapter_status value = 2 }
	}
	else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_we_adapter_status value = 4 } set_variable = { name = zg361_we_adapter_blocked_reason value = 2752 } }
}

# #276 consumes a genuinely older immutable case, never the current case id.
zg361_we_submit_m276_rehire_history_effect = {
	remove_variable = zg361_we_adapter_status
	remove_variable = zg361_we_adapter_blocked_reason
	if = {
		limit = {
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ad_owner SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ad_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ad_cycle_serial CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ad_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ad_state ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ad_active
				EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$ EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$ EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$ EXPECTED_STATE = 6
			}
			$TICKET_OWNER$ = { zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes }
			$TICKET_SUBJECT$ = this
			trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable = zg361_we_ad_external_rehire_ready } var:zg361_we_ad_external_rehire_ready = 0 } trigger_else = { always = yes }
			$REHIRE_ID$ > 0 $HISTORICAL_CASE_ID$ > 0 $HISTORICAL_CASE_HASH$ > 0
			$HISTORICAL_CYCLE$ < $TICKET_CYCLE$
			NOT = { $HISTORICAL_CASE_ID$ = $TICKET_CASE$ }
			$GROWTH_EVIDENCE_ID$ > 0 $GROWTH_EVIDENCE_HASH$ > 0
			$FUTURE_COHORT_CYCLE$ > $TICKET_CYCLE$
			$HISTORY_RETAINED$ = 1 $MISCONDUCT_HISTORY_RETAINED$ = 1
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_ad_external_rehire_ready value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_ad_external_rehire_consumed value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_ad_external_rehire_id value = $REHIRE_ID$ }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_ad_external_rehire_historical_case_id value = $HISTORICAL_CASE_ID$ }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_ad_external_rehire_historical_case_hash value = $HISTORICAL_CASE_HASH$ }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_ad_external_rehire_historical_cycle value = $HISTORICAL_CYCLE$ }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_ad_external_rehire_growth_evidence_id value = $GROWTH_EVIDENCE_ID$ }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_ad_external_rehire_growth_evidence_hash value = $GROWTH_EVIDENCE_HASH$ }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_ad_external_rehire_future_cohort_cycle value = $FUTURE_COHORT_CYCLE$ }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_ad_rehire_history_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_ad_rehire_history_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_ad_rehire_history_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_ad_rehire_history_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_ad_rehire_history_state value = 6 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_adapter_status value = 1 }
	}
	else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_we_adapter_status value = 4 } set_variable = { name = zg361_we_adapter_blocked_reason value = 2761 } }
}

# #277 joins B2's committed one-slot PIP settlement directly with an
# independent native-confirmed exit receipt.  The adapter freezes only the
# native exit half: it never copies, signs or consumes the B2 source.  A/B
# consume both sources atomically after the case-kernel operation receipt;
# route C never enters this adapter or touches either source.
zg361_we_submit_m277_closed_pip_exit_effect = {
	remove_variable = zg361_we_adapter_status
	remove_variable = zg361_we_adapter_blocked_reason
	if = {
		limit = {
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ad_owner SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ad_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ad_cycle_serial CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ad_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ad_state ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ad_active
				EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$ EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$ EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$ EXPECTED_STATE = 6
			}
			$TICKET_OWNER$ = { zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes }
			$TICKET_SUBJECT$ = this
			trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable = zg361_we_ad_external_pip_exit_ready } var:zg361_we_ad_external_pip_exit_ready = 0 } trigger_else = { always = yes }
			has_variable = zg361_we_m274_hired
			has_variable = zg361_we_m274_position_type_id
			has_variable = zg361_we_formal_hc_active
			has_variable = zg361_we_formal_hc_active_case
			var:zg361_we_m274_hired = 1
			var:zg361_we_m274_position_type_id > 0
			var:zg361_we_formal_hc_active = 1
			var:zg361_we_formal_hc_active_case = $TICKET_CASE$
			has_variable = zg361_b2_workforce_pip_pending
			has_variable = zg361_b2_workforce_pip_consumed
			has_variable = zg361_b2_workforce_pip_owner
			has_variable = zg361_b2_workforce_pip_subject
			has_variable = zg361_b2_workforce_pip_cycle
			has_variable = zg361_b2_workforce_pip_case
			has_variable = zg361_b2_workforce_pip_state
			has_variable = zg361_b2_workforce_pip_case_id
			has_variable = zg361_b2_workforce_pip_case_hash
			has_variable = zg361_b2_workforce_pip_closure_receipt_id
			has_variable = zg361_b2_workforce_pip_closure_receipt_hash
			var:zg361_b2_workforce_pip_pending = 1
			var:zg361_b2_workforce_pip_consumed = 0
			var:zg361_b2_workforce_pip_owner = $TICKET_OWNER$
			var:zg361_b2_workforce_pip_subject = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
			var:zg361_b2_workforce_pip_cycle > 0
			var:zg361_b2_workforce_pip_case > 0
			OR = {
				var:zg361_b2_workforce_pip_state = 3
				var:zg361_b2_workforce_pip_state = 4
			}
			var:zg361_b2_workforce_pip_case_id > 0
			var:zg361_b2_workforce_pip_case_hash > 0
			var:zg361_b2_workforce_pip_closure_receipt_id > 0
			var:zg361_b2_workforce_pip_closure_receipt_hash > 0
			NOT = { var:zg361_b2_workforce_pip_case_id = var:zg361_b2_workforce_pip_closure_receipt_id }
			NOT = { var:zg361_b2_workforce_pip_case_hash = var:zg361_b2_workforce_pip_closure_receipt_hash }
			$EXIT_CONFIRMED$ = 1 $EXIT_RECEIPT_ID$ > 0 $EXIT_RECEIPT_HASH$ > 0
			$FORMER_SLOT_ID$ > 0
			$DISPLACED_HOURS$ >= 0 $DISPLACED_COST_RECEIPT$ > 0
			$EXITED_CHARACTER$ = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
			NOT = { $EXIT_RECEIPT_ID$ = var:zg361_b2_workforce_pip_case_id }
			NOT = { $EXIT_RECEIPT_ID$ = var:zg361_b2_workforce_pip_closure_receipt_id }
			NOT = { $EXIT_RECEIPT_HASH$ = var:zg361_b2_workforce_pip_case_hash }
			NOT = { $EXIT_RECEIPT_HASH$ = var:zg361_b2_workforce_pip_closure_receipt_hash }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_ad_external_pip_exit_ready value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_ad_external_pip_exit_consumed value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_ad_external_exit_receipt_id value = $EXIT_RECEIPT_ID$ }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_ad_external_exit_receipt_hash value = $EXIT_RECEIPT_HASH$ }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_ad_external_exit_former_slot_id value = $FORMER_SLOT_ID$ }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_ad_external_exit_displaced_hours value = $DISPLACED_HOURS$ }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_ad_external_exit_displaced_cost_receipt value = $DISPLACED_COST_RECEIPT$ }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_adapter_status value = 1 }
	}
	else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_we_adapter_status value = 4 } set_variable = { name = zg361_we_adapter_blocked_reason value = 2771 } }
}
